steps.title: 3 · The raid

steps.title: 4 · Displacement / shift
steps.body: bear displacement at 09:30 ET — body 18.00pt, 2.5× ATR — BEFORE the raid: this is the leg into the sweep, not the reaction to it

steps.title: 5 · The array and the entry
steps.body: No entry array priced.

steps.title: 6 · Verdict: WAIT
steps.body: LTF shift + displacement — LTF confirm sweep_only. Confluence 0.72 (A).

steps.title: 7 · If you had not waited
steps.body: Market long at 7695.00, stop 7688.00 one tick beyond the raid wick (7.00pt = 1R), T1 7711.69 = 2.38R. Stopped at 7688.00 on the 10:00 ET bar (−1R). Result: LOSS -1.00R (the level broke).

cases.lesson: The desk said WAIT because "LTF shift + displacement" was not there. Taking it anyway cost -1.00R on this tape. That is the price of one missing layer — measured, not asserted.
